recent_en: SALIRAN recently saw a series of announcements of open-market share acquisitions by Executive Chairman DATUK LIAW CHOON WEI, along with a material litigation announcement. The company also changed its company secretary and released its quarterly results for the period ended 30 September 2026.
notable_en: Executive Chairman DATUK LIAW CHOON WEI acquired shares in the company on multiple occasions in the open market in October 2026.
The company made a material litigation announcement.
The company changed its company secretary, involving HUAN HUI SHIN and LIM LIH CHAU.
risks_en: The company has ongoing material litigation.
The Executive Chairman declared an intention to deal in shares during the closed period.
